integrity: Proof uses independently verified exact graph enumerations, regular CW orbit incidence, 37 triangle eliminations, 32 elementary collapses, and standard covering/Bockstein facts. All reproducibility artifacts are embedded.
scientific_limitations: This is a finite single-graph orbit-space homology and mod-two ring classification; no homotopy equivalence to RP2 wedge S2 or general widths is established. An unindexed equivalent result remains a priority risk.
title: Integral torsion and the mod-two cup square in an antipodal Möbius-ladder independence quotient
